dct_description_sm: 1) Document Inuit knowledge on plants with a focus on shrubs, particularly berry species; 2) Map the sites where berry picking has taken place in the past decades and where this activity is still practiced; 3) Document Inuit perceptions of climate change on climate effects per se (wind, rain, snow, ice, temperature), plants, animals and human.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK)
dct_title_s: Local and traditional ecological knowledge of vegetation and the environment in the context of climate change at Kangiqsualujjuaq, Nunavik
